verdict.rationale: Speechmatics documents API keys scoped to projects, temporary keys that avoid exposing long-lived credentials, and tokens that manage API keys programmatically. Together these give agents some credential isolation. Scoping is only shown at the project level, though, and there is no evidence of per-permission or per-endpoint restrictions. missing for 10: permission- or action-level key scopes, documented least-privilege role options for keys, detail on temporary-key lifetime and limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: scope API keys to projects, and track usage per project
temporary keys should be used to avoid exposing your long-lived API key.
Automate workspace administration with tokens that create projects and manage API keys programmatically.
